name: Evidence-based complexity estimator and model selection
description: The current complexity estimator is effectively always 'medium', pushing most work to Sonnet. This undermines cost control and model-aware execution. This PRD replaces the estimator with a scored rubric, persists outcomes, and begins learning from telemetry and PRD archives.

userStories.title: Replace heuristic estimator with scored rubric
userStories.description: FADE should compute complexity from multiple signals rather than a single heuristic.
acceptanceCriteria: Estimator produces `simple|medium|complex` based on a scored rubric with documented factors (e.g., file count, cross-module changes, security-sensitive areas, data migrations, unknown APIs).
Estimator writes its decision and factor scores to telemetry (`model_selected` event).
Operator can override model explicitly and the override is recorded.

userStories.title: Learn from outcomes to reduce cost and failures
userStories.description: FADE should begin using run history to adjust selection and surface when the estimator is wrong.
acceptanceCriteria: FADE maintains `fade/metrics/model-history.json` (or similar) storing per-model outcomes: success rate, retries, regression failures, average duration per story.
If a run exhibits repeated retries or BLOCKED, FADE suggests escalating model (e.g., from haiku→sonnet→opus) and records the suggestion.
Provide `fade estimator explain` to print the rubric decision for a given PRD.
